stories.title: Mold’s outgoing Mayor raises over £7,500 for Kidsbank Flintshire and Macmillan
stories.summary: Mold has a new Mayor for the 2026/27 municipal year. Cllr Jo Edwards was elected Mayor of Mold at Mold Town Council’s Annual Meeting on Wednesday 6 May, with Cllr Pete Dando elected as Deputy Mayor. stories.title: Chester Cathedral to host free public discussion on life, death and consciousness
stories.summary: Chester Cathedral is hosting a free public panel discussion on life, death and consciousness later this month. The event, titled Life, Death and Consciousness: What happens next?, takes place on Tuesday 26 May and is the latest in the cathedral’s Assemble series. It is open to everyone and free to attend. stories.title: Ken Skates appointed interim leader of Welsh Labour after election hammering
stories.summary: Ken Skates has been appointed interim leader of Welsh Labour following the party’s defeat at Thursday’s Senedd election. The Fflint Wrecsam MS, who took the only Labour seat in the new six-member constituency, received unanimous backing from the Welsh Labour group on Friday. stories.title: Jack Sargeant loses Senedd seat after eight years representing Alyn and Deeside
stories.summary: Jack Sargeant has lost his Senedd seat after eight years representing Alyn and Deeside. The Welsh Labour Minister for Culture, Skills and Social Partnership stood as second on his party’s list in the new Fflint Wrecsam constituency at Thursday’s Senedd election.
